system.description: For reasons unknown to you or your sire, your Embrace left you with the imprint of a third eye upon your forehead — an unwelcome reminder of Tremere's diablerie of Saulot. It renders you an embarrassment to other Tremere and a figure of distrust to all who don't know you well; unless concealed under a hood or beneath your hair, the stigma is obvious to any who see you. All Social rolls suffer +2 difficulty when interacting with any Cainites outside your coterie or closest allies. Attempting to pass as a Salubri is not advisable.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
